title: Move to the Zero Trust Cybersecurity Model
description: Adopt the Zero Trust cybersecurity model with Victrix. Reduce the risk of attack and simplify identity management for your organization.

sections.title: Move to the Zero Trust Cybersecurity Model
sections.lead: The Zero Trust model takes a "never trust, always verify" approach: each user and device is continuously verified and authorized, minimizing security risks and opportunities for successful attacks. Victrix can help you implement it and improve your security posture.
